description: Private IRIS-X derived Granite 4.2 8B offline material. IBM official weights, tokenizer, configuration, template, model card and Apache-2.0 license are preserved from ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b revision f8de16cdcdbc6c779ca517604e050d82cc119e44. This is an explicitly modified artifact: the shard weight_map and total_size are rebuilt from all verified official safetensors headers. No tensor values changed. The original official index and v1 manifest are retained in provenance/ alongside INDEX_REPAIR_NOTICE.txt. Root derived-v2 manifest binds every upstream hash and the independently reviewed repaired index. Complete material hash/config/native vocabulary/header/provenance checks passed. No full model load, GPU training or Kaggle notebook execution has been performed. Runtime code and wheels are separately versioned private Datasets.
